# Skeleton

The shape of content that is loading.

- Status: implemented
- Category: feedback
- Pattern: HTML `aria-hidden placeholders; the container is aria-busy`

## Anatomy

- **block**: Sunken surface blocks.

## Variants

- `text`:
- `media`:

## States

- `default`

## Accessibility

- Role: none (aria-hidden)
- No shimmer under reduced motion.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide (A)
- 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions (AAA)

## Tokens

| Token | CSS custom property |
| --- | --- |
| `skeleton.fill` | `--skeleton-fill` |
| `skeleton.highlight` | `--skeleton-highlight` |
| `skeleton.radius` | `--skeleton-radius` |

## Platforms

| Platform | Implementation |
| --- | --- |
| web | .nd-skeleton |

Web: `.nd-skeleton` in kit.css.

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-stack" aria-busy="true">
  <span class="nd-visually-hidden">Loading content</span>
  <span
    class="nd-skeleton"
    aria-hidden="true"
    style="inline-size: 60%"
  ></span>
  <span class="nd-skeleton" aria-hidden="true"></span>
</div>
```
